title: gives every offered preset a title of its own, and nothing else one
why: An offered preset left without a title: the build refuses it, and at run time the screen would name it by its id again, which the mutation job can see though it does not typecheck.

title: says GIF in the title of every GIF, since the chooser says nothing after its size
why: A GIF titled without the word: the chooser drops a GIF's format after its size, so the option would read as a still.
